payload.body: You tend to avoid the same kind of authority, hide the same desire, or leave at the same point in a difficult conversation. The reaction feels unquestionably true because it once protected you and has been repeated many times since. Underneath is a familiar strategy that may still be answering an older problem. Check what is different now before repeating the usual refusal.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct the South Node can make an old refusal feel so familiar that instinct and habit are difficult to separate.
